sections.heading: Cracks let water in, and water does the real damage.
sections.body: Most stucco work starts as a crack and becomes a moisture problem. Repairing the surface without finding how water got behind it just hides the fault until the next season.

pages.heading: EIFS repair and replacement.
pages.intro: EIFS can be repaired, or replaced with hard-coat stucco to remove the water problems the system is known for.
pages.seoTitle: EIFS Repair Chicago IL | Stucco Repair Chicago
pages.seoDescription: EIFS repair in Chicago, and replacement with hard-coat stucco to eliminate the water intrusion problems associated with the system.

sections.heading: Exterior Insulation and Finish System.
sections.body: EIFS is a non-load-bearing cladding that gives exterior walls an insulated, finished surface. It has been used in North America since the 1960s, first on masonry and mainly on wood-framed buildings since the 1990s.

sections.heading: Water intrusion is the known weakness.
sections.body: EIFS has a long-documented history of water penetration problems and the structural damage that follows, which is why newer systems incorporate a drainage plane to let water escape from behind the cladding. Where an older system is failing, replacing it with hard-coat stucco removes most of the issue rather than patching around it.

sections.kicker: Why it is worth doing properly
sections.heading: Floating and finishing are the hard part.
sections.body: Drywall is versatile and cost effective: it takes paint, texture or a wall covering. Hanging it is not the difficult bit. Floating and finishing are, and without the right tools and technique the result announces itself across the wall.

sections.heading: A small hole does not stay small.
sections.body: Damaged drywall is a fairly easy fix with the right tools and experience, but left in disrepair the damage spreads and the eventual repair is larger. We patch the board and match the paint so the damage disappears rather than becoming a visible patch.

pages.heading: Interior and exterior painting.
pages.intro: Painting as its own job, and as the finishing step that makes a stucco or drywall repair invisible.
pages.seoTitle: Painting Chicago IL | Stucco Repair Chicago
pages.seoDescription: Interior and exterior painting in Chicago, including colour-matched finishing after stucco and drywall repairs.

sections.heading: The repair is only finished when it disappears.
sections.body: A patched wall that does not match is still a visible repair. Matching the existing paint is the step that turns a fix into a finish, and it is why painting sits alongside the drywall and stucco work rather than apart from it.
